description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling 'ThingCreated' events within the Eclipse Ditto project. It updates the 'Thing' object's lifecycle, revision, modification time, creation time, and metadata based on the event data.

classes.name: ThingCreatedStrategy
classes.description: A final immutable class that extends AbstractThingEventStrategy to handle 'ThingCreated' events. It overrides the handle method to set lifecycle, revision, timestamps, and metadata of the 'Thing' based on the event data.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the 'ThingCreated' event, updating the 'Thing' object with lifecycle set to ACTIVE, revision number, timestamps, and metadata extracted from the event.
